response.sql: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_avgs t, overall o WHERE t.type_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_avg FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.type_avg FROM kept k, kept_mean m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_avg), remaining_avg AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS r_avg FROM remaining) SELECT ra.r_avg AS avg_type_price, ra.r_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, ra.r_avg - km.mean_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM remaining_avg ra, overall o, kept_mean km;
